name: Evolution — Mechanistic Wright–Fisher Population (selection, mutation, heritable variation)
description: Fig 11 upgraded to a real population-genetics model (PopulationGeneticsProcess wrapping a Wright-Fisher EvolvingPopulation at carrying capacity 300). Each generation, viability selection samples parents in proportion to a Gaussian fitness on the trait-optimum distance, offspring inherit the parent trait plus a Gaussian mutation, and the environmental optimum drifts. Selection response obeys the breeder's equation, the population tracks the moving optimum with a steady-state lag, and beyond a critical drift rate the lag runs away (adaptation failure). This single seeded run demonstrates the engine through process-bigraph; the many-seed ensembles, phylogeny and sweeps live in the tests and the figure builder. Mechanistic variant of fig11-evolution (kept as the didactic place-graph baseline).
